title: pdfcore-words/1
description: Word-level text with positions for one PDF. Coordinates are PDF points with the origin at the top-left of the page's visible box (CropBox ∩ MediaBox), after applying /Rotate. Glyph boxes: horizontally the glyph advance; vertically top = baseline − ascent·size, bottom = baseline − descent·size (font metrics). Text: ligatures U+FB00–U+FB06 expanded, then NFC. A word ends at whitespace, at a baseline change > 0.5·size, or at a horizontal glyph gap > 0.2·size. Words are in reading order (see docs/pdfcore-words-1.md). Numbers are rounded to 0.01. Within /1 only additive changes are allowed; readers must ignore unknown fields.

hasTextLayer.description: true when at least one non-whitespace glyph was extracted

pages.description: Pages processed (all, or the --pages selection), in order. width/height are the displayed (rotated) size of the visible box.

font.description: Base font name without a subset prefix (ABCDEF+).
